commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Windshield Wiper Motor Driver Side (V216) faulty
Windshield Wiper Motor Driver Side (V216) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Engine Hood Contact Switch
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Windshield Wiper Motor Driver Side (V216)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Windshield Wiper Motor Driver Side (V216)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Golf (1K): Central Elektroniği (in Combination with 02071), Kontrol edin: for Aftermarket Xenon installation.
Aftermarket Xenon installations may destroy the Wiper Elektroniği, installations like this are usually illegal and use H7 Bulb mounts for the Xenon bulbs.
Slightly more on that can be found under Xenon Headlight Retrofitting
